# Fisheye & Panini

Re-projects the perspective frame: an equidistant fisheye that bulges the center, or a Panini projection that keeps verticals straight and widens the view without stretching the edges.

<EffectDemo effect="fisheye" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { fisheye } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/fisheye';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(fisheye({ preset: 'actionCam' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.projection = 'fisheye'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter                   | Type                  | Default     | Range      | Description                                                                 |
| --------------------------- | --------------------- | ----------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projection` _(structural)_ | 'fisheye' \| 'panini' | `'fisheye'` |            | The projection to apply.                                                    |
| `strength`                  | number                | `0.6`       | 0 – 1      | 0 leaves the image unchanged; 1 is a full fisheye or classic Panini.        |
| `fov`                       | number                | `60`        | 20 – 120 ° | Diagonal field of view the original frame was rendered with.                |
| `zoom`                      | number                | `1`         | 0.5 – 2    | Crops in (above 1) or shows more (below 1).                                 |
| `edges`                     | boolean               | `true`      |            | Black outside the original frame (otherwise the edge pixels are stretched). |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                        |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `actionCam` | `strength: 0.8`, `zoom: 1.1`                                    |
| `peephole`  | `strength: 1`, `zoom: 0.8`                                      |
| `panini`    | `projection: 'panini'`, `strength: 1`, `fov: 100`, `zoom: 1.15` |
| `gentle`    | `strength: 0.3`                                                 |

Apply one with `fisheye({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.11 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 5.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/fisheye`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Equidistant fisheye projection; Sharpless, Postle and German, Pannini: A New Projection for Rendering Wide Angle Perspective Images, CAe 2010 (inverse Panini mapping).
